staticPrompt: Bright midday sunlight over a real city block, seen from an elevated chase camera above a dark yellow sports coupe on a grid of sunlit streets. Grey asphalt roads marked with yellow centre dashes and white crosswalk bars run between low flat-roofed concrete shops with painted signs and awnings, kerbs, pavements and street lamps along both sides; pedestrians in everyday clothes and work uniforms stand along the walkways, each over a faint coloured ring painted on the ground. Clear blue sky, crisp shadows, sharp daylight on grey asphalt.

dynamicPrompts.text: The coupe slams into a mage and sends them flying across the street.
The coupe slams into a firefighter and sends them flying across the street.
The coupe slams into a worker and sends them flying across the street.
The coupe slams into a nurse and sends them flying across the street.
The coupe slams into a firefighter and sends them flying across the street.
Struck a second time, the firefighter lies dead on the asphalt.
Victory — the streets are clear and the round comes to an end.
